prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished landscape 16:9 raster prototype sprite of the complete UPGRADES panel for the mining roguelike Tiefenhall. Match the supplied reference screenshot as style reference only: dark richly textured horizontal walnut planks, fine beveled brass borders and riveted corners, warm ivory serif typography, realistic hand-painted fantasy game UI, subtle cave visible around panel. Entire frame visible, front-on, sharp readable German UI. This is a proposed interactive panel, not a screenshot to reproduce. Necessary concise labels only, no explanatory paragraphs, no developer annotations, no watermark. Header 'Upgrades', top right compact balances '12 Powerup-Punkte' and '3 Komfortpunkte'. Bottom left 'Zurück', bottom right 'Punkte zurücksetzen'. All layouts show normal dark wood cards, soft luminous gold edge for hover, orangegold interior ONLY on one selected card; unavailable actions subdued. Use handsome thematic item illustrations (heart, lantern/lightning, coin pouch, boots, jumping boot, pickaxe) not emoji. Preserve meaningful readable whitespace. Powerup ranks and effects examples: Startgeld Rang 4/20 +40 → +50 Gold cost 1 point; Bewegung Rang 3/10 +3% → +4% cost 3 points; Sprunghöhe Rang 2/10 +1,6% → +2,4% cost 2 points; Gesundheit Rang 5/20 +12,5% → +15% cost 3; Energie Rang 2/20 +5% → +7,5% cost2; Abbauverbrauch Rang 1/20 −1% → −2% cost2. Purchase buttons use '+ 1 Punkt', '+ 2 Punkte' or '+ 3 Punkte' matching their cards. No extra gameplay systems or fictional unlocks. VARIANT 1: Direct purchasing tile grid. Two rows of three spacious cards under a compact 'Powerups' / 'Komfort' tab pair, Powerups active. Each card has a large centered illustration, name, rank line, a tasteful small segmented horizontal rank meter, current effect → next effect, and wide brass-framed purchase button at its bottom. Startgeld is hovered with gold edge but dark wood interior; Bewegung normal; Sprunghöhe normal. A clear, balanced 3 by 2 composition, immediate understandable click targets, more refined than a list. All six cards fully visible.
